sceneConcept: A powerful forty-six-year-old Chinese underground excavation captain stands alone against a transparent background in a three-quarter rear stance. He has a thick neck, broad muscular back, weathered tan skin, cropped black hair threaded with grey and dark stubble. His plain charcoal work jumpsuit, unmarked orange vest, utility belt, work gloves and heavy boots are worn but orderly. He carries a plain unworn yellow hard hat low at one side and suddenly cups the other hand near his ear, looking back into an unseen tunnel; the back of his neck shows a simple lighter band from years under the helmet. Soft even frontal studio light creates no voices, runes, dust scenery, supernatural effects or bright rim. Visual refresh: a scarred industrial lower-leg prosthesis beneath high-visibility tunneling equipment.
